entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With governance of Pales assigned..."
entries.dialogueText: "With governance of Pales assigned to House Azaro, tensions persist with local forces, but long-term integration is steadily underway."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Following the return to prewar bor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Following the return to prewar borders, no incidents have occurred, and while military buildup on the Pales side remains high, further hostilities are not anticipated."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The division of Pales is marked by..."
entries.dialogueText: "The division of Pales is marked by conflict, though tensions remain manageable, particularly along the new shared border, with full integration expected to take decades."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""But despite lingering dissatisfact..."
entries.dialogueText: "But despite lingering dissatisfaction, most Rizians accept the outcome as the war finally ends."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The loss of the Pales Administrati..."
entries.dialogueText: "The loss of the Pales Administrative District has led to ongoing conflict between Palesian forces and Rizian civilians."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In other developments, the Aureus..."
entries.dialogueText: "In other developments, the Aureus gas field is now fully under Rizian control."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In other developments, Pales’ decl..."
entries.dialogueText: "In other developments, Pales’ declaration of neutrality toward Lespia has greatly diminished our norther neighbor's influence in the region, shifting the balance of power."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In other developments, the acquisi..."
entries.dialogueText: "In other developments, the acquisition of the Port of Pales has greatly enhanced Rizian trade."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With moderate damage sustained dur..."
entries.dialogueText: "With moderate damage sustained during the war, reconstruction is progressing steadily."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The heavy devastation inflicted du..."
entries.dialogueText: "The heavy devastation inflicted during the war has made reconstruction a long and arduous process before full recovery can be achieved."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With minimal damage caused by the..."
entries.dialogueText: "With minimal damage caused by the war, our reconstruction efforts are progressing rapidly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite full funding dedicated to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite full funding dedicated to reparations, widespread bitterness and anger among many Palesians toward Rizia make reconciliation a prolonged and difficult process."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With full funding dedicated to rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "With full funding dedicated to reparations, tensions are slowly easing, however a significant portion of the population still resents Rizia, complicating progress."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""With full funding dedicated to rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "With full funding dedicated to reparations, substantial progress has been made."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Reparation efforts are ongoing, ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reparation efforts are ongoing, however, widespread bitterness and anger among many Palesians toward Rizia is making it a prolonged and difficult process."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Reparation efforts are ongoing, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reparation efforts are ongoing, and while tensions are slowly easing, a significant portion of the population still resents Rizia, complicating progress."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Reparation efforts are ongoing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Reparation efforts are ongoing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Through the marriage of Vina and A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Through the marriage of Vina and Axel Reinhart, Rizia and Pales have solidified a powerful alliance, swiftly stabilizing relations as their territory merges into one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The partnership between Rizia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The partnership between Rizia and Pales regarding the Aureus gas field remains profitable, with potential for future expansion if current trends continue."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The deal for Rizia to continue buy..."
entries.dialogueText: "The deal for Rizia to continue buying gas from Pales is still in place, ensuring ongoing energy cooperation between the two nations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our military alliance remains stro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our military alliance remains strong, effectively countering the influence of Lespia in the region."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Pales' membership in GRACE has pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales' membership in GRACE has proven beneficial for all kingdoms involved."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Pales' membership in Intermerkopum..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales' membership in Intermerkopum has proven beneficial for all countries involved, strengthening their economic influence and position on the global stage."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""To put it simply, relations betwee..."
entries.dialogueText: "To put it simply, relations between Rizia and Pales have become increasingly strained as the Grand Duchy becomes ever more aligned with Lespia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Tensions have only worsened with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tensions have only worsened with the recent announcement of Duke Reinhart’s impending marriage to the daughter of a prominent LesPower executive."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our position in the conflict remai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our position in the conflict remains resilient, though with minimal territorial gains on either side, it feels as if we’re edging toward a stalemate."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our position in the conflict is we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our position in the conflict is weakening, with gradual losses of territory and little to show for our efforts, but our men continue to fight the good fight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our position in the conflict is di..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our position in the conflict is dire, with significant losses of territory and no sign of relief. Despite the mounting setbacks, our men continue to fight bravely."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Integration has gotten off to a ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Integration has gotten off to a rocky start as the Palesians experience a steep decline in living standards compared to what they were used to under the Reinharts."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Integration has been largely succe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Integration has been largely successful, as the Palesians experience living standards comparable to that which they were used to under the Reinharts."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Complicating matters, taxes under..."
entries.dialogueText: "Complicating matters, taxes under Rizian rule are significantly higher than what Palesian citizens are accustomed to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The heavy devastation inflicted du..."
entries.dialogueText: "The heavy devastation inflicted during the war left reconstruction at a standstill, as inadequate funding made any meaningful recovery impossible."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This has sparked frustration among..."
entries.dialogueText: "This has sparked frustration among the aristocracy and resentment over the belief that their contributions are bailing Rizia out of its current economic downturn."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Complicating matters further, taxe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Complicating matters further, taxes under Rizian rule are significantly higher than what Palesian citizens are accustomed to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How tragic. I’ll be sure to shed a..."
entries.dialogueText: "How tragic. I’ll be sure to shed a tear for them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unfortunately, stability comes at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, stability comes at a cost."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did they think joining Rizia meant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did they think joining Rizia meant a free ride?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just as expected. Order and prospe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as expected. Order and prosperity endure under strong leadership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, I suppose there's little rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I suppose there's little reason for concern."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A stable present is no guarantee o..."
entries.dialogueText: "A stable present is no guarantee of a stable future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That sounds like Axel's problem to..."
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds like Axel's problem to deal with, not mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I suppose they'd rather go bac..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I suppose they'd rather go back to propping up the Lespians' lifestyles?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then we may need to consider what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we may need to consider what can be done to ease tensions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As extraction infrastructure expan..."
entries.dialogueText: "As extraction infrastructure expands, profits continue to rise, securing long-term economic gains."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This move has also strengthened ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "This move has also strengthened our naval presence, bolstering both economic and strategic influence in the region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will fight to the bitter end.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will fight to the bitter end."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite the premature end to reuni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the premature end to reunification talks, relations between Rizia and Pales have maintained a cautious yet cordial tone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The marriage between Duke Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: "The marriage between Duke Reinhart and the princess continues to strengthen ties between our two realms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dammit. I might as well have marri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dammit. I might as well have married her off to Rico."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as Vina's happy, everythin..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Vina's happy, everything will be fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as those two are together,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as those two are together, there's still hope."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The tide will turn. I know it in m..."
entries.dialogueText: "The tide will turn. I know it in my heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To hell with their little alliance..."
entries.dialogueText: "To hell with their little alliances. We'll continue to watch them from afar."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll reunite someday. I know it.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll reunite someday. I know it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I assume my invitation got lost in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assume my invitation got lost in the mail."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Touching, but wars cannot be fough..."
entries.dialogueText: "Touching, but wars cannot be fought on courage alone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our victories need not stop there...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our victories need not stop there. Now that we have conquered Pales, Merkopa is ours for the taking."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As expected, this move has isolate..."
entries.dialogueText: "As expected, this move has isolated us on the world stage and weakened our ability to influence global decisions on security and trade."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Rizia's withdrawal from the Allian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's withdrawal from the Alliance of Nations has been impossible to ignore."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, it has reduced the risk o..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, it has reduced the risk of foreign influence and strengthened our diplomatic flexibility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope we stand strong enough alon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope we stand strong enough alone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What a tragedy -- to rule ourselve..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a tragedy -- to rule ourselves without permission."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God’s will is not debated in forei..."
entries.dialogueText: "God’s will is not debated in foreign halls!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. Rizia bows to no one.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Rizia bows to no one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've shut the door behind us. Let..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've shut the door behind us. Let's hope we didn't lock ourselves in."

entries.dialogueText: "With war now inevitable between Rumburg and Sordland, Queen Beatrice has formally requested aid to bolster their war effort."

entries.title: Narrator: ""Rumburg and Sordland have reached..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In response to Sordland joining CS..."
entries.dialogueText: "In response to Sordland joining CSP, Queen Beatrice has urged GRACE to transition into a military alliance, citing the need for greater defense cooperation among monarchies."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Queen Beatrice has secured a stead..."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Beatrice has secured a steady supply of cheap gas, easing tensions while ensuring Rumburg’s energy stability."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""If they succeed, we must be cautio..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they succeed, we must be cautious regarding future energy dealings."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This concludes the report. Signed,..."
entries.dialogueText: "This concludes the report. Signed, Lucita Azaro, Councilor of War and Internal Security."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The government has cracked down on..."
entries.dialogueText: "The government has cracked down on pro-Rizian dissent in the region, seeking out and punishing those who openly took our side in the referendum."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""They have grown increasingly hosti..."
entries.dialogueText: "They have grown increasingly hostile toward Rizia, challenging our borders as they seek to expand their influence, which has led to a few clashes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The government has grown increasin..."
entries.dialogueText: "The government has grown increasingly hostile toward us, contesting our borders as they seek to expand their influence, which has led to a few clashes."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "This concludes the report. Signed, General Taddeus Azaro, Councilor of War and Internal Security."

entries.dialogueText: "This concludes the report. Signed, Captain Titus Gordion, Councilor of War and Internal Security."

entries.dialogueText: "The Golcondist Protectorate's government has grown increasingly hostile toward the rest of Rizia, challenging our borders as they seek to expand their influence."

entries.title: Narrator: ""The mood is happy, but Zille's rei..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mood is happy, but Zille's reintegration into Rizia under direct control of the Crown has brought with it significant challenges."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The mood is happy, but Zille's rei..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mood is happy, but Zille's reintegration into the province of Brenas has brought with it significant challenges."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Unsurprisingly, the controversy su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unsurprisingly, the controversy surrounding the referendum interference has led to continued protests among some parts of the population."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We have seen isolated incidences o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have seen isolated incidences of Su Omina members violently evicting Wehzek families from their homes, claiming the land belongs to 'real' Rizians."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Meanwhile, your treaty with Wehlen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, your treaty with Wehlen, granting Wehzek citizens full rights as Rizians, has helped ease the transition for those who opted to stay."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Your treaty with Wehlen, granting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your treaty with Wehlen, granting Wehzek citizens the same labor protections as Rizians, has eased the transition process somewhat."

entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite ongoing unrest, the self-p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite ongoing unrest, the self-proclaimed 'Holy Golcondist Protectorate of Zille' is codifying Golcondist teachings into law and embedding them into daily life."

entries.title: Narrator: ""The self-proclaimed 'Wruhecist Rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "The self-proclaimed 'Wruhecist Republic of Zille' maintains stability under Wruhecist rule, with political freedoms intact but governed by state-enforced religious doctrine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The self-proclaimed 'Bludish Repub..."
entries.dialogueText: "The self-proclaimed 'Bludish Republic of Zille' faces ongoing unrest as ethnic tensions persist between the Bluds, Wehzeks and Rizians in the region."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Zille maintains stability under th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille maintains stability under their self-proclaimed Zille Liberation Front."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The situation in Zille remains unc..."
entries.dialogueText: "The situation in Zille remains unchanged under Wehlen's control."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, they have grown increasin..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, they have grown increasingly hostile toward Rizia, contesting our borders as they seek to expand their influence, leading to clashes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The leaders have recently reached..."
entries.dialogueText: "The leaders have recently reached out to seek an alliance with Rizia, viewing our influence as vital to their religious and political goals."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "Their leadership has already reached out, viewing Rizia as a natural ally and key to their political ambitions."

entries.dialogueText: "They've recently reached out to form an alliance with Rizia, seeing our influence as crucial to their political goals."

entries.title: Narrator: "I had come to the end of the docume..."
entries.dialogueText: I had come to the end of the document. Vina's name and position as Foreign Affairs Councilor were neatly printed at the bottom of the page.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Signed, Queen Consort Lucita Azaro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Signed, Queen Consort Lucita Azaro Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "Signed, Queen Consort Lucita Azaro Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Meanwhile, we have redoubled our e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, we have redoubled our efforts to locate and rescue Princess Vina. So far, to no avail."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our refusal to accept Pales' cease..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our refusal to accept Pales' ceasefire demands -- unreasonable as they may have been -- has lost us a great deal of international support. Still, I believe our lost territory is worth the battle."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""On a positive note, Rizia and Wehl..."
entries.dialogueText: "On a positive note, Rizia and Wehlen's shared custodianship of the Aureus gas field has gone smoothly so far."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our partial acquisition of the Por..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our partial acquisition of the Port of Pales has also greatly enhanced Rizian trade."

entries.title: Narrator: ""Rumburg and our GRACE partners wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg and our GRACE partners would certainly approve of this move, if only as a measure to further destabilize Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""It bears repeating that there is n..."
entries.dialogueText: "It bears repeating that there is no love lost between Anton Rayne and the Bluds. If we take the Bludish Republic's side, our relations with Sordland will inevitably suffer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our Intermerkopum partners have ur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Intermerkopum partners have urged us to approach this offer with caution, given the fledgling status of our alliance and the poor international reputation of the Bludish people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Taking the Bluds' side will endear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Taking the Bluds' side will endear us to Sordland, which has taken steps to recognize and reconcile with its own Bludish population."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The decision is yours.""
entries.dialogueText: "The decision is yours."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As a reminder, we are in need of n..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a reminder, we are in need of new allies after the loss of our GRACE membership, and we can ill afford to antagonize our new neighbors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Rumburg has not acknowledged the n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg has not acknowledged the new republic so far, though they are rumored to be sending financial support to it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Rumburg was the first nation to ac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg was the first nation to acknowledge the new republic, and are rumored to be sending financial support to it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our permanent transfer of the terr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our permanent transfer of the territory was met by limited protests from Rizians living there, which were swiftly quelled."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, Wehlen has pledged to res..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, Wehlen has pledged to respect the terms of the amended Zille Agreement. Barring no further surprises, we can expect an eventual normalizing of relations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Our lack of diplomatic ties with W..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our lack of diplomatic ties with Wehlen means those families who were separated by the Zille transfer will not be reunited anytime soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""As hostilities between Rumburg and..."
entries.dialogueText: "As hostilities between Rumburg and Sordland become an inevitability, it remains to be seen whether Zilleans, along with the rest of Wehlen, are drawn into the fray."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Naturally, Derdia was the first to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally, Derdia was the first to acknowledge this new republic, and is rumored to be sending funding to it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""For the time being, it appears tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the time being, it appears that Derdia has been holding the leadership back from directly challenging Rizia's borders."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if there was anything I..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if there was anything I could do to foster goodwill among the Palesians.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.dialogueText: I decided to offer the people of Pales the option to become dual Palesian-Rizian citizens.
entries.menuText: Offer citizens of Pales the option to obtain Rizian passports.

entries.dialogueText: I decided to turn "Reunification Day" into a Rizian national holiday.
entries.menuText: Turn "Reunification Day" into a Rizian national holiday.
